text: Atomic writes shall have release semantics; reads shall have acquire semantics. A read observing an atomic write shall synchronize with that actual write. Successful compare/exchange and RMW shall be read/write; failed compare/exchange shall be an acquiring read. Equal numeric values shall not substitute for observed-write identity.
